question: What are the three tiers of the Government in India?

options.text: Union government, Judiciary government and Federal government
Union government, State Government and Federal Government
Union government, State government and Judiciary government
Union Government, State Government and Local Government

solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Government, State Government and Local Government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The three tiers of the Government in India** are the **Union Government, State Government, and Local Government**.
 
• The Union Government is also known as the Central Government and has the authority to govern the entire country.
 
• The State Government governs individual states within the country.
 
• The Local Government operates at the grassroots level, including municipalities and panchayats.
 
• This three-tier system helps in decentralizing the power and administration, ensuring better governance and more effective public service delivery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** establishes this three-tier system to ensure a balance of power and responsibilities between different levels of government.
 
• The **Union List**, **State List**, and **Concurrent List** in the **Seventh Schedule **of the Constitution specify the subjects on which each tier of government can legislate.
 
• The Union Government deals with matters of national importance, the State Government handles regional issues, and the Local Government focuses on local administration and community needs.
